description: Spring Boot configuration class for the Device Connection service, setting up beans for Vert.x, Tracer, AMQP endpoint, remote cache, health check, and metrics.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for setting up beans related to device connection, cache, health check, and metrics.

methods.name: vertx
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vert.x instance configured with VertxProperties.

methods.name: vertxProperties
methods.description: Provides VertxProperties configured via application properties.

methods.name: getTracer
methods.description: Resolves and returns an OpenTracing Tracer, defaulting to a no-op tracer if none is found.

methods.name: amqpProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for AMQP endpoint.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory bean for DeviceConnectionAmqpServer instances.

methods.name: remoteCacheProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for remote cache connection.

methods.name: remoteCacheManager
methods.description: Creates a RemoteCacheManager with the specified configuration.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Configures metrics registry with common tags for the service.

methods.name: healthCheckProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for health check endpoint.

methods.name: healthCheckServer
methods.description: Creates a health check server instance.
